acip: MA GRUB NA, DNGOS PO CHOS CAN, SHES BYA'I BYE BRAG YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD SHES BYA YIN, KHYOD SHES BYA DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING SHES BYA YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, dngos po chos can, shes bya'i bye brag yin par thal, khyod shes bya yin, khyod shes bya dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, khyod ma yin zhing shes bya yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa du ma grub pa'i phyir
english: I disagree that working things characteristic of knowable things. Suppose you do disagree. Then let's consider, again, working things. They are so characteristic of knowable things, Because (1) they are knowable things; (2) they are related to knowable things in such a way that to be a working thing is to be a knowable thing; and (3) there are many examples of things which are not working things but are still knowable things.
